inputs.text: SSANU’s one-month ultimatum over the 2009 agreement is the predictable result of obligations left unresolved for years. It is easy to make workers the villains when students fear disruption, but that blame lets government off the hook for failing to honor its commitments. Students and workers are both being harmed by a system that treats education and labor rights as expendable. The answer is not to silence collective action; it is to meet the obligations and fix the institutional neglect that keeps pushing these disputes into crisis.
